CHARTERING MARKET AT HAND:
HANDYSIZE AND SUPRAMAX/ULTRAMAX// WEEK 39
Supramax/Ultramax and Handy Markets Strengthen Across the Atlantic
Spot South Atlantic Supramax/Ultramax market
continues to strengthen this week. Rates have risen
across all routes, with some deals being signed
significantly above previous levels. In West Africa,
shipowners are expecting a similar upward trend,
particularly in terms of shipments to India.
